name: Solar Alternatives, Inc.
old_description: Since 2008, Solar Alternatives has proudly helped thousands of commercial and residential property owners across Louisiana install modern solar panel systems that strengthen a property’s energy efficiency and overall value.
about:
Solar Alternatives, Inc. was founded in 2008 in New Orleans, Louisiana. The company serves commercial and residential property owners across the state, focusing on solar energy systems and related services.

The firm designs and installs solar photovoltaic systems, battery storage, and electric-vehicle charging equipment for homes and businesses. It also provides repair, maintenance, and cleaning services for existing solar arrays, including 24‑hour emergency response. Its team includes expert engineers and certified installers who develop custom system designs tailored to each property’s energy profile. The company reports having served thousands of customers throughout Louisiana.

Solar Alternatives works primarily with residential homeowners in the New Orleans area and commercial property owners across Louisiana. Its residential projects address high electricity costs, frequent grid outages, and hurricane‑related power loss, while its commercial installations help businesses reduce operating expenses and meet sustainability goals.

The company emphasizes a full‑service model that spans initial design through ongoing maintenance, backed by comprehensive warranties. It highlights its local expertise — engineers and installers familiar with New Orleans’ climate and building codes — as a key differentiator, along with the use of certified, durable solar products and responsive service support.
